'''RK-C3''' was a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] stationed at the remote [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]]. During the [[Seizure of CZ-198]] in [[3638 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was expropriated and reprogrammed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Now a Republic patriot, the droid eagerly invited Republic personnel to report to the [[Department of Adjudication]] members aboard the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="TOR" />
